W-Br: Hi, it's Martina from Accounting. I'd like to reserve the main conference room for a meeting I'll be leading on Friday with colleagues from our New York office. W-Am: Satoshi, have you already started working on the budget for next year? M-Au: Not yet... but I do plan to start it in the next day or so. W-Am: OK, perfect. I'd like to add some new engineers to my team next year if we can afford it. I thought one might be enough, but I realized we'll probably need three to handle our company's new contracts. M-Au: No problem. I can include that in the budget. I'll just need the details about the positions, including the job titles and expected salaries. Could you send that to me?

M-Cn: Welcome to Business Suit Outlet. How can I help you? W-Br: Hello. I'm interviewing for a job next week, and I wanted to buy a new suit. M-Cn: Congratulations! Do you have anything particular in mind? W-Br: Well, there's one in your display window that looks nice. But I don't really like the color... M-Cn: That one only comes in black. But we do have suits in other colors that are fashionable and appropriate for business. W-Br: OK. I can only spend 150 dollars, and I'd like a style similar to the one in the window. M-Cn: Let me show you some suits in that price range. By the way, any alterations needed for the suit are included in the price.

W-Br: Ellenville Public Library. How can I help you? M-Cn: Hi, I'm calling from the company Grover and James. We're interested in filming a scene for a movie in the lobby of the library. Its historic architecture is just what we're looking for. W-Br: Well... we actually had a film shoot in our library last year. And the thing is... they said it would take one day and it ended up taking three. I'm concerned that will happen again. M-Cn: I understand, but this is a very short scene. W-Br: Well, we have a board meeting here next week. I could give you ten minutes at the beginning to give us the details.

M-Au: Excuse me, I'm looking for Axel Schmidt's painting titled The Tulips. W-Am: Unfortunately, his paintings aren't on display. But it's just temporary—we're putting new flooring in that gallery. If you come back in a couple of weeks, the floors will be done, and you can see all of Schmidt's artwork. M-Au: Oh, that's too bad. I really wanted to see that painting. W-Am: I'm sorry about that. But we sell items featuring that painting in the gift shop. You could buy a souvenir so you could enjoy The Tulips every day!

W-Br: Hey, Dmitry. Are you still working on your sales report? Collecting all the data from the car dealerships in my region is taking me such a long time. Especially because this year management wants additional information on vehicle purchases, like model and color... M-Au: Are you using the sales computation software? That's what I used for my report, and it worked really well. W-Br: Oh—you already finished it? M-Au: Well—I'm done collecting and analyzing the data, but I'm having trouble with the presentation. We didn't get any guidelines for that. W-Br: Remember Julie's presentation last year? It was very impressive. The slides are available on our company intranet.

W-Am: Thanks for coming in, Omar. You might've heard that Rosa Garcia is retiring at the end of November. This means her position as director of information security in Singapore will be vacant. I'd like to know if you'd be interested. M-Cn: Oh! That would be a promotion for me. Well, hmm. I'll need a little time to think about it and talk it over with my family. I do have a question. When would I start the position? W-Am: The first week of December ideally. We'd pay for all your moving expenses, of course. If you decide to accept the offer.

M-Cn: Maryam, did you hear that our construction company won the bid to build the river dam next to Burton City? W-Br: I did! This is such a major project for us... the dam's expected to produce enough electricity to power all of Burton. M-Cn: Right. Say, do you know when construction will begin? W-Br: I don't, but here comes the project manager now. He may have a better idea... Gerhard, are there any updates on the dam construction? M-Au: Well, we're going to have to wait until all the permits are approved. It'll be a while before anything else can happen.

M-Au: I have a question about a customer's prescription—he's... oh, I'm sorry. I see you're busy. W-Am: I don't have much to do. M-Au: His doctor prescribed a 30-day supply of this allergy medication, but I noticed we only have enough on the shelf for fifteen days. W-Am: Our weekly delivery arrives early tomorrow morning. M-Au: Then maybe we should increase the number of bottles in our next order from the distributor.

M-Cn: Good morning, Ms. Davis. We've received comments from your legal team on the terms and agreements for the travel rewards credit card that we issued. M-Cn: Hello, Bellevue Apartments Management Office. Can I help you? W-Am: Hi, I'm Azusa Suzuki. I'm a new tenant here, and I live in 2A. M-Cn: How's everything in your apartment so far? W-Am: Yes. And, I'll be stopping by your office tomorrow with my February rent check. M-Cn: OK. See you then.

W-Am: Hello, this is Karen Smith. I have an appointment with Dr. Miller for my annual eye exam on Tuesday. Unfortunately, I won't be able to make it. If possible, I'd like to reschedule for later in the week. If Dr. Miller is available in the afternoon, that would work better for me. I also wanted to ask about your warranty for eyeglasses. What exactly does the warranty cover? Thank you, and please call me back at 555-0110.

M-Cn: Curious about how chocolate is made? Then come visit us at Bodin's Chocolate Factory! You'll have a great time. We offer guided tours every Saturday and Sunday at our factory, located directly across from Appleton Shopping Center. During your two-hour visit, you'll observe the creation and packaging of Bodin's products. And each visitor will get their picture taken with Cheery, our adorable chocolate mascot, to take home as a souvenir. Right now, with the coupon available on our Web site, you can bring in a group of twelve or more people for half the price. Download yours today!

W-Br: Attention, everyone. Unfortunately, we've had to stop the movie. As you've probably noticed, we're having technical difficulties with the audio. I'm very sorry about this—we take our sound quality seriously and want you to know we'll have technicians here as soon as possible to resolve this issue. As you exit, please stop by the customer service desk in the lobby to pick up two free tickets for your next movie. Again, my apologies for the inconvenience.

W-Am: Welcome to Branson Tech's second annual conference on computer security. We decided to try something different to publicize the event this year. We advertised primarily through social media rather than by e-mail newsletters or on company Web sites. And over 300 people are here! The first presentations will begin in fifteen minutes. The talks will take place in different rooms throughout the building, so please be sure to check your programs for the list of topics, speakers, and locations.

M-Au: Welcome, everyone. On behalf of the Department of Transportation, I'd like to announce a new experimental program to reduce traffic in Greenville. Beginning in January, there will be a ten-dollar fee for each car that enters the city. There will, however, be a lower fee for people who commute to Greenville for work. They will be asked to pay five dollars rather than ten dollars. These charges are aimed at deterring drivers from coming into this very crowded area. The program will be in effect for three months. After that, we will determine if the program has decreased traffic congestion enough to continue it permanently.

W-Br: Thanks for tuning in to Music Today on Radio 49. First, a reminder that the Classical Music Festival is this weekend. Radio 49 is giving listeners a chance to win a pair of tickets by entering a contest. And tickets are almost sold out. Just go to our Web site and tell us what you enjoy most on our station, and we'll pick a winner at random. This year is the tenth anniversary of the event, which was founded by a famous classical musician, Umesh Gupta. On tomorrow morning's program, Mr. Gupta will be here for an interview about the history of the festival. Be sure to join us for that.

W-Am: Thank you for visiting our booth here at the trade fair. We're so excited to show you our new patio furniture. You're probably familiar with our wooden outdoor tables and chairs, and we want you to know that we've expanded that line to include plastic furniture. This furniture is very durable. It can withstand any kind of weather—and it needs no maintenance. I'm going to hand out a sample of the plastic material we use. Please pass it around after you've had a chance to look at it.

W-Br: This is Noriko, the human resources supervisor here in Albany. I'm calling about your request to transfer to our branch in Havertown... I know your commute is difficult, and it takes you over an hour to drive to this office. So I've contacted the manager at that location, and there is a need for a skilled software engineer. There are a few forms that you'll need to fill out, though, to complete the request. Now we need to talk about your work schedule to decide when you'll start at the new location. Please call me back.

M-Cn: You're listening to Making My Company with Mark Sullivan. In each episode I invite entrepreneurs from around the world to talk about how they built their successful businesses. In celebration of our radio show's ten-year anniversary, our Web site now has all of our previously aired episodes. You can access them with the click of a button. You can even download them onto mobile devices to listen to on the go! OK, now, I welcome Haru Nakamura to the show. Ms. Nakamura is excited to be here today.

M-Au: It's Akira, calling from the district manager's office. The visual merchandising team wants to make a slight change to the fall display standards that we sent you yesterday. They want to move the shirts with the vertical stripes—hang them instead of having them displayed on the shelf. We'll display some colorful accessories there instead, like scarves and ties. Also, hang all the socks on gridwall panels by the cash registers. Those sell best when people can grab them when they walk up to pay. The thicker, cold-weather socks will be shipped to you soon. You'll get an e-mail confirmation with the details when they're sent.

Testing Dates: January 10–12
Number of Participants: 8

Dr. Maritza Geerlings
Poseidonstraat 392
Paramaribo
Suriname

Dear Dr. Geerlings,

I am writing to thank you for your years of service on the faculty of the Jamaican Agricultural Training Academy (JATA) and to let you know about some exciting developments. As you know, JATA was originally established as a vocational school for agriculture but now offers courses in a varied array of disciplines, including cybersecurity, electrical engineering, and health information management. Our student body, which for the first ten years consisted almost exclusively of locals, is now culturally diverse, with students from across the Americas and Europe. Today's students work with sophisticated equipment, much of which did not exist in our early days.

To reflect these and other significant changes that JATA has undergone over time, the Board of Trustees has approved a proposal by the Faculty Senate to rename the institution the Caribbean Academy of Science and Technology. As a result, a new institutional logo will be adopted. All students and faculty members, both current and former, are invited to participate in a logo design contest. Information about the contest will be forthcoming.

The renaming ceremony and the introduction of the new logo will take place at 11 A.M. on 1 June, the twentieth anniversary of the institution. We hope you will be able to join us.

Sincerely,
Audley Bartlett

Jamaican Agricultural Training Academy

Alberta Business Matters
April issue

Improve Your Office Environment Now!

Today's office environment, featuring numerous corridors, unexciting beige or white walls, and often rows of identical, windowless cubicles, might not inspire comfort, beauty, and energy. However, there are some easy, inexpensive ways to make your office space more inviting.

Air quality

Add some green plants to the décor. Plants offer a natural filtration system, increasing oxygen levels. Nonflowering plants should be preferred, as they will not scatter pollen.
A small, tabletop air purifier helps improve stale air and removes dust.

Light quality

Take breaks and go outdoors. Even just five minutes before or after lunch break will provide your eyes with a respite from artificial light sources.
Use desktop lamps with full-spectrum lightbulbs.
Install double-glazed windows instead of blinds to reduce glare while maintaining natural light.

Stress relief

Earplugs or noise-cancelling headphones can block distracting noise in an open office floor plan.
Photographs of loved ones and places we have visited for vacation are reminders of our life away from the office. Select a few favorite pictures as important decorative elements.

Dear readers, if you have tips to add to this list, send them in and they will be published in next month's issue.

Best,
Maria Testa

Anton Building

Clanton (12 October)—The planned renovation of the historic Anton Building by Jantuni Property Developers (JPD) is facing new delays. A JPD spokesperson says their negotiations with the city regarding a package of subsidies and tax incentives are ongoing and are proving somewhat contentious. According to the renovation plan, JPD must protect the historical integrity of the Anton Building while it creates a mixed-use interior, offering both office space and lower-level retail space. However, JPD's city permit to do the project is on hold pending the current negotiations.

This is making city revitalization advocates increasingly anxious. Aditi Yadav comments, "This plan to create useful space out of an empty decaying building will go a long way to restoring vibrancy to that area of the city. I sincerely hope that JPD does not back out. In creating their offer, the City Council should consider JPD's excellent record of beautifully restoring and maintaining several other historic buildings in Clanton."

questions.explanation: "Conveniently located" = nằm ở vị trí thuận tiện, là cụm từ cố định thường dùng trong văn bản thương mại. "Regularly" = thường xuyên (không bổ nghĩa cho "located"), "brightly" = sáng sủa, "collectively" = tập thể - đều không phù hợp.

questions.stem: Because of transportation ------- due to winter weather, some conference participants may arrive late.
questions.explanation: Sau "transportation" cần danh từ để tạo cụm danh từ "transportation delays" (sự chậm trễ giao thông). "Delays" là danh từ số nhiều phù hợp. "Are delayed/had delayed" là động từ không thể đứng sau danh từ "transportation", "to delay" là dạng nguyên mẫu.

questions.stem: Proper maintenance of your heating equipment ensures that small issues can be fixed ------- they become big ones.
questions.explanation: "Before they become big ones" = trước khi chúng trở thành vấn đề lớn. Liên từ "before" diễn tả trình tự thời gian phù hợp với mục đích phòng ngừa. "As a result" = do đó, "in addition" = thêm vào đó, "although" = mặc dù - đều không hợp nghĩa.

questions.stem: The information on the Web site of Croyell Decorators is ------- organized.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho phân từ "organized". "Clearly organized" = được tổ chức rõ ràng. "Clear" là tính từ, "clearest" là so sánh nhất (cần "the"), "clearing" là V-ing không phù hợp vị trí này.

questions.stem: Payments made ------- 4:00 P.M. will be processed on the following business day.
questions.explanation: "After 4:00 P.M." = sau 4 giờ chiều. Giới từ "after" đứng trước mốc thời gian cụ thể. "Later" là trạng từ không đứng trước giờ cụ thể, "than" là liên từ so sánh, "often" là trạng từ tần suất.

questions.stem: The Copley Corporation is frequently ------- as a company that employs workers from all over the world.
questions.explanation: "Frequently recognized as" = thường xuyên được công nhận là, là cụm từ cố định. "Recognized as" diễn tả sự đánh giá/công nhận. "Permitted" = được phép, "prepared" = đã chuẩn bị, "controlled" = được kiểm soát - đều không hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.stem: Greenfiddle Water Treatment hires engineers who have ------- mathematics skills.
questions.explanation: "Advanced mathematics skills" = kỹ năng toán học nâng cao/cao cấp, là cụm từ chuyên môn phổ biến. "Adjusted" = đã điều chỉnh (không mô tả kỹ năng), "eager" = háo hức (cảm xúc), "faithful" = trung thành - đều không hợp với "mathematics skills".

questions.stem: After ------- the neighborhood, Mr. Park decided not to move his café to Thomasville.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ "after" cần V-ing (danh động từ). "After evaluating the neighborhood" = sau khi khảo sát khu phố. "Evaluation" là danh từ không có tân ngữ trực tiếp sau, "evaluate" là nguyên mẫu, "evaluated" là quá khứ không đứng sau giới từ.

questions.stem: The average precipitation in Campos ------- the past three years has been 22.7 centimeters.
questions.explanation: "For the past three years" = trong ba năm qua, là cụm giới từ cố định dùng với thì hiện tại hoàn thành để chỉ khoảng thời gian liên tục. "On/to/under" không tạo cụm thời gian phù hợp.

questions.stem: Improving efficiency at Perwon Manufacturing will require a ------- revision of existing processes.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "revision". "Creative revision" = sự sửa đổi sáng tạo. "Create" là động từ, "creativity" = sự sáng tạo (danh từ trừu tượng), "creation" = sản phẩm sáng tạo (danh từ) - đều không đứng trước danh từ khác.

questions.stem: Conference attendees will share accommodations ------- they submit a special request for a single room.
questions.explanation: "Unless they submit" = trừ khi họ nộp. "Unless" = if not, diễn tả điều kiện phủ định: mặc định chia sẻ phòng, trừ khi có yêu cầu đặc biệt. "Even" cần kèm "if", "similarly/also" là trạng từ không nối mệnh đề.

questions.stem: To receive -------, please be sure the appropriate box is checked on the magazine order form.
questions.explanation: Sau "to receive" cần danh từ làm tân ngữ. "Renewals" (sự gia hạn - danh từ số nhiều) là danh từ phù hợp. "Renew" là động từ, "renewed" là tính từ/quá khứ phân từ, "to renew" là dạng nguyên thể không làm tân ngữ cho "receive".

questions.stem: Donations to the Natusi Wildlife Reserve rise when consumers feel ------- about the economy.
questions.explanation: "Feel confident about" = cảm thấy tự tin về, là cụm từ cố định. "Confident about the economy" diễn tả sự lạc quan kinh tế thúc đẩy quyên góp. "Careful" = cẩn thận, "helpful" = hữu ích, "durable" = bền lâu - đều không hợp với "feel... about the economy".

questions.stem: When ------- applied, Tilda's Restorative Cream reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho phân từ bị động "applied". "When consistently applied" = khi được sử dụng đều đặn/nhất quán. "Consistent" là tính từ, "consist" là động từ (không có dạng bổ nghĩa phân từ), "consisting" là V-ing không phù hợp vị trí này.

questions.stem: The marketing director confirmed that the new software program would be ready to ------- by November 1.
questions.explanation: "Ready to launch" = sẵn sàng ra mắt/phát hành, là cụm từ chuẩn trong ngữ cảnh phần mềm/sản phẩm. "Facilitate" = tạo điều kiện, "arise" = nảy sinh/xuất hiện, "exert" = gắng sức - đều không phù hợp với "ready to ___".

questions.stem: Satinesse Seat Covers will refund your order ------- you are not completely satisfied.
questions.explanation: "If you are not completely satisfied" = nếu bạn không hoàn toàn hài lòng. "If" diễn tả điều kiện phù hợp nhất với chính sách hoàn tiền. "Yet" = vẫn chưa (trạng từ), "until" = cho đến khi (không hợp ý nghĩa), "neither" = cũng không.

questions.stem: In the last five years, production at the Harris facility has almost doubled in -------.
questions.explanation: "Doubled in volume" = tăng gấp đôi về sản lượng/khối lượng, là cụm từ chuẩn trong ngữ cảnh sản xuất. "Majority" = đa số, "edition" = ấn bản (không liên quan sản xuất), "economy" = nền kinh tế - đều không phù hợp với "doubled in ___".

questions.stem: Ms. Tsai will ------- the installation of the new workstations with the vendor.
questions.explanation: Sau "will" cần động từ nguyên thể. "Be coordinating" tạo thành "will be coordinating" (tương lai tiếp diễn), đúng ngữ pháp và diễn tả hành động sẽ tiến hành. "Coordinated" = quá khứ phân từ (không dùng sau will), "to coordinate" = "will to coordinate" sai ngữ pháp, "coordination" = danh từ.

questions.stem: An upgrade in software would ------- increase the productivity of our administrative staff.
questions.explanation: "Significantly increase" = tăng đáng kể, là cụm từ chuẩn trong văn bản kinh doanh. "Significantly" bổ nghĩa cho động từ "increase". "Persuasively" = thuyết phục, "proficiently" = thành thạo, "gladly" = vui lòng - đều không hợp với "increase".

questions.stem: The Rustic Diner's chef does allow patrons to make menu -------.
questions.explanation: Sau "make menu" cần danh từ. "Make substitutions" = thực hiện các sự thay thế, là cụm động từ + danh từ cố định. "Substitutions" (số nhiều) phù hợp. "Substituted/substituting" là dạng động từ, "substitute" sau "make" không tạo cụm từ chuẩn.

questions.stem: Ms. Rodriguez noted that it is important to ------- explicit policies regarding the use of company computers.
questions.explanation: "Establish policies" = thiết lập/ban hành chính sách, là cụm từ cố định chính xác nhất. "Inform" = thông báo (inform someone, không dùng với policies), "succeed" = thành công, "estimate" = ước tính - đều không hợp nghĩa.

questions.stem: ------- Peura Insurance has located a larger office space, it will begin negotiating the rental agreement.
questions.explanation: "Now that Peura Insurance has located..." = Giờ đây khi... "Now that" là liên từ diễn tả nguyên nhân khi sự việc vừa hoàn thành (dùng với hiện tại hoàn thành "has located"). "Happily" là trạng từ, "Despite" cần danh từ/V-ing sau, "In fact" = thực ra (không kết nối nguyên nhân-kết quả).

questions.stem: Mr. Tanaka's team worked ------- for months to secure a lucrative government contract.
questions.explanation: "Worked diligently" = làm việc chăm chỉ/cần cù, bổ nghĩa trực tiếp cho động từ "worked". "Readily" = sẵn sàng (không hợp với "worked for months"), "curiously" = một cách tò mò, "extremely" bổ nghĩa cho tính từ/trạng từ khác chứ không phải động từ.

questions.stem: Though Sendark Agency's travel insurance can be purchased over the phone, most of ------- plans are bought online.
questions.explanation: Cần đại từ sở hữu chỉ lại tổ chức "Sendark Agency". "Its plans" = các gói của nó (của công ty). "Its" là đại từ sở hữu dùng cho danh từ chỉ vật/tổ chức. "Whose" dùng trong mệnh đề quan hệ, "his" chỉ người nam, "this" là tính từ chỉ định.

questions.stem: Garstein Furniture specializes in functional products that are inexpensive ------- beautifully crafted.
questions.explanation: "Inexpensive as well as beautifully crafted" = rẻ cũng như được chế tác đẹp. "As well as" nối hai đặc điểm song song của sản phẩm. "Thus" = do đó (nhân quả), "at last" = cuối cùng (sau thời gian chờ đợi), "accordingly" = theo đó.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following notice.
questions.explanation: Cần danh từ sau "highest level of". "Service" (dịch vụ) là danh từ phù hợp nghĩa trong ngữ cảnh công ty quản lý bất động sản phục vụ khách thuê.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following notice.
questions.explanation: Cần giới từ chỉ thời gian khoảng. "During this time" (trong thời gian này) là cụm giới từ thông dụng, phù hợp với ngữ cảnh nhà vệ sinh ngừng hoạt động trong khoảng thời gian bảo trì.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following notice.
questions.explanation: "We apologize for any inconvenience" (Chúng tôi xin lỗi vì sự bất tiện) là cụm từ chuẩn trong thông báo dịch vụ khách hàng. Cần động từ diễn tả sự xin lỗi.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following notice.

options.text: If you would like to join our property management team, call us today.
Thank you for your patience while the main lobby is being painted.
Please do not attempt to access the north lobby on these days.
Questions or comments may be directed to the Management Office.

questions.explanation: Câu kết thúc thông báo cần hướng dẫn liên hệ nếu có thắc mắc. "Questions or comments may be directed to the Management Office." (Mọi câu hỏi hoặc ý kiến có thể gửi đến Văn phòng Quản lý) là câu phù hợp nhất để kết thúc thông báo.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following customer review.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ / động từ "tailored". "As quickly as possible" (nhanh nhất có thể) — "quickly" là trạng từ phù hợp cú pháp và nghĩa.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following customer review.
questions.explanation: "He gave me his full attention even though his shop was busy." — "Even though" (mặc dù, dù) là liên từ nhượng bộ phù hợp, thể hiện sự tương phản giữa cửa hàng bận mà vẫn chú ý đến khách.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following customer review.

options.text: Of course, the shop is busiest on Saturdays.
The suit fits me perfectly too.

questions.explanation: Sau khi nói vest được hoàn thành sớm hơn cam kết (hai ngày thay vì ba ngày), câu tiếp theo nên nhấn mạnh chất lượng. "The suit fits me perfectly too." (Bộ vest vừa vặn hoàn hảo) bổ sung khen ngợi phù hợp, dùng "too" để nối với ý khen trước.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following customer review.
questions.explanation: "He is a superb tailor." (Ông là một thợ may tuyệt vời) — "Superb" (tuyệt vời, xuất sắc) phù hợp nhất với giọng điệu khen ngợi cao của bài đánh giá. "Best" cần mạo từ "the", không dùng "a best".

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following letter.

options.text: In the event of bad weather, the animals will be inside.
There are no exceptions to this policy.
Ones younger than that can find much to enjoy.
This fee includes lunch and a small souvenir.

questions.explanation: Sau khi nêu quy định về độ tuổi tối thiểu (6 tuổi), câu bổ sung cần nhấn mạnh tính bắt buộc. "There are no exceptions to this policy." (Chính sách này không có ngoại lệ) phù hợp nhất để khẳng định quy định được áp dụng nghiêm túc.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following letter.
questions.explanation: "Educational activities" (các hoạt động giáo dục) phù hợp nhất trong ngữ cảnh trường học đến thăm trang trại. Các hoạt động như làm phô mai và nuôi ong đều mang tính giáo dục.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following letter.
questions.explanation: "Two of these events must be scheduled in advance." — "Events" (sự kiện, hoạt động) là danh từ phù hợp nhất để chỉ các hoạt động (cheese-making class và beekeeping) cần đặt lịch trước.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following letter.
questions.explanation: "Please let me know your selection" (Vui lòng cho tôi biết lựa chọn của bạn) — đại từ tân ngữ "me" (tôi) phù hợp vì người viết là Annabel Romero đang yêu cầu người nhận thông báo cho bà.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: "We are proud to introduce" (Chúng tôi tự hào giới thiệu) — sau động từ "to be" cần tính từ. "Proud" (tự hào) là tính từ phù hợp cú pháp và nghĩa.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following e-mail.

options.text: They include general and cosmetic procedures.
We have relocated from neighboring Hillsborough.
The Web site is a creation of A to Z Host Builders.
Several of them are surprisingly expensive.

questions.explanation: Câu trước đề cập đến "danh sách các dịch vụ trên trang web". Câu bổ sung cần mô tả nội dung danh sách đó. "They include general and cosmetic procedures." (Chúng bao gồm các thủ thuật thông thường và thẩm mỹ) — "they" chỉ lại "procedures", cung cấp thêm thông tin có ích.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: "Contact our center today at 305-555-0121 to schedule an initial evaluation." — Sau động từ "contact" (ra lệnh hành động), dùng động từ nguyên thể "to schedule" để diễn tả mục đích.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: Trong ngữ cảnh phòng khám nha khoa, người đến khám được gọi là "patients" (bệnh nhân). "First-time patients" (bệnh nhân lần đầu) là cụm từ chuẩn trong lĩnh vực y tế.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?

options.text: To give an update on a technical problem
To introduce a new reservation system
To advertise airline routes to some new cities

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"a problem... has been repaired" (sự cố... đã được sửa) → "an update on a technical problem" (cập nhật về một vấn đề kỹ thuật)

questions.stem: According to Mr. Clifford, what has the airline temporarily increased?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"added more on-site customer service representatives at airports" (bổ sung thêm nhân viên dịch vụ tại sân bay) → "Assistance for customers at airports" (hỗ trợ khách hàng tại sân bay)

questions.stem: What are applicants for this position required to have?

options.text: A university degree in language studies
An office with a reception area

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"have a computer, a headset, and high-speed Internet access" (có máy tính, tai nghe và Internet tốc độ cao) → "Certain pieces of equipment" (một số thiết bị nhất định)

questions.stem: What is true about the job?

options.text: It offers a choice of assignments.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"Choice of projects" (lựa chọn dự án) → "a choice of assignments" (sự lựa chọn trong nhiệm vụ)

questions.stem: What is true about the software testing?

options.text: It included multiple versions of Konserted.
It was done over several days.
It required participants to complete a survey.
It took place at a series of concerts.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"January 10–12" (ba ngày kiểm thử) → "done over several days" (được thực hiện trong nhiều ngày)

questions.stem: What action was difficult for users to complete?

options.text: Posting reviews to a Web site

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"Task number 3" = "participants invited friends to a concert" (người tham gia mời bạn dự buổi hòa nhạc) → "Inviting friends to a performance" (mời bạn dự buổi biểu diễn)

questions.stem: What is indicated about Ms. Atiyeh's previous appearance at Mutamark?

options.text: It was moved to a larger venue.
It took place at the Koros Hall.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"drew a sizeable crowd" (thu hút đông đảo khán giả) → "very well attended" (được tham dự rất đông)

questions.stem: How many people can the Koros Hall accommodate?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"capacity of 270" (sức chứa 270) → đáp án trực tiếp 270 người

questions.stem: When will Ms. Atiyeh most likely appear at the Mutamark conference?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"the last day of the conference" với hội nghị diễn ra "from 17 to 20 September" → ngày cuối là September 20

questions.stem: What kind of business most likely is Saenger, Inc.?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"to build a monorail system" (xây dựng hệ thống tàu một ray) → "A construction firm" (công ty xây dựng)

questions.stem: What is indicated about the monorail?

options.text: It needs more funding from investors.
It will take years to finish.
It was proposed by airport officials.
It offers discounted tickets to city residents.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"expected to be completed within four years" (dự kiến hoàn thành trong vòng bốn năm) → "will take years to finish" (sẽ mất nhiều năm để hoàn thành)

questions.stem: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Along the way, the line will stop at nine stations."
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Câu này mô tả lộ trình của tàu (chín ga dừng). Vị trí [3] nằm sau thông tin về doanh thu từ bán vé [2] và trước thông tin về tiến độ xây dựng [4] — đây là vị trí hợp lý nhất để bổ sung chi tiết về tuyến đường.

questions.stem: At 3:01 P.M., what does Ms. McCall most likely mean when she writes, "No problem"?

options.text: She did not have any issues logging on to her computer.
She does not think a document has errors.
She is willing to review a document.
She has time to meet representatives from Keyes Elegant Home.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"Would you like me to revise anything... or just check" (Bạn có muốn tôi xem xét...) cho thấy bà McCall sẵn sàng đọc và xem xét tài liệu → "willing to review a document"

questions.stem: What type of work does Ms. McCall most likely do?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"Advertising Strategies" is her "area of expertise" (lĩnh vực chuyên môn) → "Marketing" (tiếp thị / quảng cáo)

questions.stem: What is suggested about the craft fair?

options.text: It takes place in downtown Staffordsville.
It is being held for the first time.
It specializes in locally produced crafts.

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"rain or shine" (dù mưa hay nắng) + "tenting to protect from rain" (lều che mưa) → hội chợ tổ chức ngoài trời → "It will be held outdoors"

questions.stem: What is NOT mentioned as a requirement for selling at the craft fair?

options.text: Sharing a space with another participant

questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
"whether or not they want to share" (dù có muốn chia sẻ hay không) → chia sẻ gian hàng là TÙY CHỌN, không phải yêu cầu bắt buộc → đây là điều KHÔNG được đề cập như một yêu cầu

questions.stem: What does Ms. Renaldo most likely sell?
questions.explanation:
Paraphrase:
Đây là lời cảnh báo riêng dành cho bà Renaldo về sự cạnh tranh cao trong nhóm "jewelry makers" → bà Renaldo bán đồ trang sức → "Jewelry"

questions.stem: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Make sure they clearly represent the items you wish to offer for purchase at the event."
